messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to install RPostgreSQL on my Mac (using R 2.13.1, Mac OS X Snow 
Leopard).

I installed PostgreSQL using Homebrew (`brew install postgresql`), and now 
I'm trying to install RPostgreSQL from source, using

     R --arch=i386 CMD INSTALL RPostgreSQL_0.1-7.tar.gz 
--configure-args='--with-pgsql-libraries=/usr/local/Cellar/postgresql/9.0.2/lib 
--with-pgsql-includes=/usr/local/Cellar/postgresql/9.0.2/include'

according to this documentation<http://code.google.com/p/rpostgresql/wiki/MacOSXInstallFinkPostgresql>, 
but I'm getting this error:

** testing if installed package can be loaded
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object 
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL/libs/i386/RPostgreSQL.so':
  
dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL/libs/i386/RPostgreSQL.so, 
6): Symbol not found: _PQbackendPID
  Referenced from: 
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL/libs/i386/RPostgreSQL.so
  Expected in: flat namespace
 in 
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL/libs/i386/RPostgreSQL.so
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed
* removing 
‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL’
* restoring previous 
‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/library/RPostgreSQL’

Any idea what's wrong?

messages.subject: Release 0.2 ?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dirk and Neil,

Its close to one year after Release 0.1-7,
and during this time, 
1 an important string escape problem (issue 31: this is really 
important I think) was solved
2 temporary file for dbWriteTable is no more made
3 a way to deal with schema was implemented

Major unresolved issues are array and other complex data types that 
does not seem easy to implement.  
Another remaining issue is suppression of unintentional 
connection cloning. This is also not very trivial.

So, I think we may consider to release 0.2 soon. 
How do you think?
-- 
Tomoaki NISHIYAMA

Advanced Science Research Center,
Kanazawa University,
13-1 Takara-machi, 
Kanazawa, 920-0934, Japan
